crossRefs.note: These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua…
These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of…
Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.
These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

Nun his son, and Joshua his son.

people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Aaron, high priest after his father

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
translations.bsb: “These are the names of the men who are to assign the land as an inheritance for you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.
translations.kjv: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
translations.asv: These are the names of the men that shall divide the land unto you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
